import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from datetime import tzinfo
from datetime import Parser
from datetime import FixedTzOffset
from datetime import RepeatedNameError
def test_dt_format_to_regex():
    parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    regex = parser.dt_format_to_regex()
    assert regex.fullmatch('2022-07-25 14:30:00')
def test_date_convert():
    date_str = '2022-07-25 14:30:00'
    format_str = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'
    tz = FixedTzOffset(timedelta(hours=1))
    assert date_convert(date_str, format_str, tz).utcoffset() == timedelta(hours=1)

class TestParser(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse(self):
        parser = Parser('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        date_str = '2022-07-25 14:30:00'
        assert parser.parse(date_str) == datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

class TestExtractFormat(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_extract_format(self):
        date_str = '2022-07-25 14:30:00'
        format_str = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'
        assert extract_format(date_str, format_str) == datetime.strptime(date_str, format_str)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
